approximations: pbrt: equirect env resampled to a 512x512 equal-area octahedral image (pbrt-v4 only accepts that layout); scale and rotationYDeg baked in; pbrt looks up nearest-pixel while Mitsuba interpolates bilinearly.

pbrt: material 'm1': anisotropic: the GGX tangent axis is the renderer's own dp/du of the mesh uvs (the loader carries TEXCOORD_0 for anisotropic materials); on AnisotropyStrengthTest it is the glTF TANGENT within 1.9 deg per vertex (3.7 deg per flat triangle), V75
